skills.name: Melee
skills.description: Close fighting with blades and every other weapon in reach: attack and strength in one. Trained by dealing melee damage.

skills.name: Ranged
skills.description: The Rationalists' patient art of fighting from a distance. Trained by dealing ranged damage.

skills.name: Occultism
skills.description: Working the humours as weapons, and the house rites that make what its spells burn. Trained by dealing occult damage and by performing rites.

skills.name: Defence
skills.description: Taking a blow and staying up: armour, and more blood to lose. Trained by fighting in any style (see Train defence in the combat settings).

skills.name: Religion
skills.description: The faith of blood: its choirs' hymns for every style, and Cruor's verses for melee. Each level adds 10 devotion.

skills.name: Butchering
skills.description: Taking carcasses apart at the right station with the right tool. Higher levels get more out of each one.

skills.name: Mining
skills.description: Ore, salt, stone and the humour gems.

skills.name: Woodcutting
skills.description: Logs for bows, bolts, fires and casings, and charcoal for the forge.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.description: Fish for the pot, and brine for the rites.

skills.name: Foraging
skills.description: Herbs, fibres, fungi and fruit, from the roadsides to the deep fens.

skills.name: Dreaming
skills.description: Pulling fragments out of the Dreaming, where every place stands as people remember it.

skills.name: Smithing
skills.description: Bars into melee weapons, plate and the tools of gathering.

skills.name: Artifice
skills.description: The Rationalist craft: ranged weapons, ammunition and fishing gear.

skills.name: Tailoring
skills.description: Hides into leathers and fibre into robes.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.description: Fish and meat into food, which is how blood comes back.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: Herbs and extracts into potions: phlegm, bile, boosts and cures.
